justification: The main overlap is only generic: both include anthropomorphic forms or body features rendered with incised/outlined linear motifs and some circular elements. The biggest difference is that A shows a complex symmetrical scene of winged profile figures flanking and interacting with a central sacred-tree-like motif, while B shows a single frontal schematic anthropomorphic figure with facial/body markings and no comparable flanking, holding, or central-tree composition.
